author: Honkai: Star Rail
text:
Special Broadcast | "Goodbye, All of Planarcadia" Livestream Replay Collection
That ravenous beast, never truly tamed,
has broken free of THEIR cage...
and taken a seat at the dining table that is Planarcadia.
Carrying the hopes of everyone, the Nameless set forth from this place.
All hopes and opportunities lie in Astropolis...
